name: Li Zhuowu
work: Mr. Li Zhuowu's Criticism of Journey to the West
classic_quotes: This is the central theme of the whole book.
feature: The most famous Ming commentary; curses 'pedantic scholars' and points to the 'childlike mind' doctrine

name: Wang Xiangxu
identity: Qing · commentator of the Zhengdao Book of the Journey West
work: Journey to the West: The Book of Realizing the Way (Zhengdao shu)
classic_quotes: This chapter is the grand theme of realizing the Way.
Monkey-mind and horse-intent lie in a single thought.
The great Way is utterly simple; this shows it clearly.
feature: First to interpret the Journey through 'Realization of the Way'; attributes it to Qiu Chuji
layer: Early Qing · founder of the Path-of-Realization school

name: Chen Shibin
identity: Qing · commentator of the True Interpretation of the Journey West
work: The True Interpretation of the Journey West (Xiyou zhenquan)
classic_quotes: This is the great Way of the Golden Elixir.
Heart-fire and kidney-water: this shows it clearly.
The stages of cultivation are evidenced in this chapter.
feature: The most popular Qing commentary; interprets the Journey through the Golden Elixir
layer: Mid-Qing · representative of the Golden-Elixir school

name: Liu Yiming
work: The Original Intent of the Journey West (Xiyou yuanzhi)
classic_quotes: The original intent of the Journey lies in the dual cultivation of nature and life.
This chapter speaks plainly of the 'fire phases'.
The monkey-mind returns to the right; the six thieves vanish.
feature: The most systematic Neidan reading of the Journey; annotated all 100 chapters with far-reaching influence
layer: Mid-Qing · culmination of the Neidan school

name: Zhang Shushen
identity: Qing · commentator of the New Commentary on Journey to the West
work: New Commentary on Journey to the West (Xinshuo)
classic_quotes: The intent of the Journey lies in the Great Learning and the Doctrine of the Mean.
The monkey-mind is the human heart.
This chapter shows the unity of Confucianism, Buddhism, and Daoism.
feature: Interprets the Journey through Confucianism; advocates the 'unity of the three teachings'; a distinctive perspective
layer: Mid-Qing · representative of the Confucian school
